item.title: Programming
item.description: I am a strong advocate for open and inclusive scholarship. Throughout my work, I’ve frequently found myself rewriting complex Stata code from scratch, an experience that inspired two key initiatives: publishing custom Stata programs and sharing open code for public datasets to save others time.
